Review Date: Reviewed in the United States on October 23, 2024
Review Body:
Most of the complaints I see are related to the book cover. The others are obviously from Trump haters. I always felt bad for how she was shunned after they started trying to take down her husband. She was somewhat famous as a model for many years and well respected. She has been very brave and composed through all the negativity. If you read it you will see some examples of good things she tried to accomplish, much less successful when political opinion interferes.
As for small print, I bought the digital version, easy to read. Photos are beautiful and can't fall out!
